searchText: We have decided to do LIFO refund mechanism, in this particular case, the overcharged state gas will be repayed to regular first if the state_gas_spilled counter is non-zero. It should automatically address the concerns raised by <@1252939266871263294> right? Outcome would be same as what Luis proposed (i think), but yeah this is change for devnet-7 Isn't the LIFO already in glamsterdam-devnet-6? (I hate LIFO name) yeah it is for frames, but it didn't get included for eip7702 state refund, that gas is added back to reservoir always. ~~Yeah, I feel that we should use the LIFO for this case as well - if the charges were taken from reservoir, then give back to reservoir; if not, give back to gas_left~~ Edit: actually, <@1252939266871263294> proposal is cleaner, I think. So I feel we should go with that Outcome should be same, but Luis PR simplifies EIP text. Wait, I remember something: we don't want the intrinsic costs to depend on the state. So, we cannot change that during the auth processing so, we need to use LIFO True, we still want to check for max intrinsic gas, and then reduce intrinsic gas for amount of already existing accounts (and other checks). My small point here is that it should not matter that it is state refund, you can just decrease intrinsic gas and and then calculate reservoir from it. how can we decrease intrinsic gas without making a dependency between intrinsic costs and state?
